description:
Use this when someone asks about flood insurance or a flood quote for a Tennessee home.
    Starts a flood estimate and sends the shopper a 6 digit verification code.

    Requires that check_eligibility returned eligible and that the shopper read the consent text
    and agreed (consent_version from check_eligibility). building_coverage: dollars of coverage for
    the structure, 20000 to 5000000 (the rebuild cost is a good guide; 250000 is the federal program
    maximum many lenders ask for). contents_coverage: 0 to 1000000. The flood zone comes from the
    address. After verify_contact, call get_flood_quote. Prices are estimates from a test environment
    for now and cannot be bound online.
name: start_flood_quote
title: Start a flood insurance estimate
